Fixed E2E-003 (add-to-bag-from-quick-view) — code defect in modal-body.jsx where itemsAdded was passed in wrong format ({productId, price, quantity} instead of {product, variant, quantity}), crashing AddToCartModal. 8/10 tests now pass.

Remaining failure E2E-002 (switch-color-swatch-in-quick-view) is a test-code bug: the test clicks swatches.nth(1) expecting a different color swatch, but the first PLP product (25688608M) has only 1 color ("Ivory Multi"). The 6 radios are: Ivory Multi (color), then sizes 4/6/8/10/16. Clicking nth(1) clicks already-selected size "4" which doesn't change the image. The test needs to specifically target color swatches and skip if < 2 colors exist.

bugs.issue: swatches.nth(1) clicks a SIZE radio (not a second color swatch) because the first product only has 1 color. Size changes do not update the gallery image.
bugs.fix: Identify color swatches specifically (by parent fieldset, aria-label pattern, or swatch group heading). Skip test if < 2 color options. Example: filter radios to only those within the color swatch group, then click the second color.
